module: Flowgraph node "Groundmarkers" (category repeat_instant, depends on core_groundMarkers). Creates ground markers that show the path to a target. Input pins: clear (reset pulse), target (waypoint name, vec3 position or list), color (deprecated), cutOffDrivability, penaltyAboveCutoff, penaltyBelowCutoff, threshold (target change threshold, 0.1). Calls core_groundMarkers.setPath when the target changes; resetAll on stop.
notes: data.fadeStart = 100 and data.fadeEnd = 150 are defined but unused in this file.
Old pins pos, waypoint -> target and reset -> clear (legacyPins).

hasNewTarget.desc: Compares the pin target to the previous one (types, length, numeric values with the threshold threshold, strings).

returns.desc: true if the target has changed

work.desc: Handles clear (resetAll) then, if flow and target are present and the target has changed, calls core_groundMarkers.setPath(target, options).
